title: Munnar Tea Hills & Mist Escape
summary: Explore rolling tea estates, misty viewpoints, and cool highland trails in God's Own Country.
highlights: Eravikulam National Park & Nilgiri Tahr viewpoint
Tea museum walkthrough & tea tasting
Guided morning nature walk & Mattupetty Dam visit
inclusions: 2 Nights stay in premium hill resort
Daily breakfast and dinner included
Private AC cab for all transfers & sightseeing
Entry tickets to Eravikulam and Tea Museum
exclusions: Flight or train fare to Kochi

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kochi & Drive to Munnar
itinerary.description: Scenic drive through Cheeyappara and Valara waterfalls. Check-in to resort and evening stroll in spice plantations.

itinerary.title: Munnar Sightseeing Extravaganza
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Eravikulam National Park, followed by Mattupetty Dam, Echo Point, and the heritage Tea Museum.

itinerary.title: Kundala Lake & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning sunrise viewpoints at Kundala Lake, shopping for exotic spices & tea, followed by return transfer to Kochi.

title: Alleppey Houseboat Serenade & Backwaters
summary: Glid along emerald palm-fringed lagoons and canals aboard a traditional luxury Kerala houseboat.
highlights: Overnight luxury houseboat cruise along Punnamada Lake
Authentic Kerala Karimeen fish curry lunch & evening snacks
Sunset village canoe ride through narrow channels
inclusions: 1 Night on traditional Kerala houseboat with private chef
All meals: Welcome drink, lunch, evening tea, dinner, breakfast
Air-conditioned bedroom during night hours
Village exploration canoe tour
exclusions: Extra activities not mentioned in itinerary

itinerary.title: Boarding & Canal Cruising
itinerary.description: Check-in at noon with fresh tender coconut. Cruise through paddy fields, lakeside temples, and anchor for a sunset dinner.

itinerary.title: Morning Village Life & Disembarkation
itinerary.description: Wake up to misty waters, fresh traditional breakfast, canal bird watching, and checkout at 9:30 AM.

title: Wayanad Rainforest & Cave Expedition
summary: Trek through prehistoric caves, mist-draped peaks, bamboo forests, and sparkling waterfalls.
highlights: Chembra Peak heart-shaped lake trek
Edakkal prehistoric rock carvings exploration
Bamboo rafting in Kuruva Island
inclusions: 2 Nights eco-resort or treehouse stay
All meals and trail energy packs
Forest department permits & certified local trek guides
4x4 Jeep transfers to trailheads

itinerary.title: Arrival & Edakkal Caves
itinerary.description: Climb Ambukuthi Hills to explore Neolithic rock engravings. Relax at evening campfire.

itinerary.title: Chembra Peak Trek & Soochipara Falls
itinerary.description: Challenging morning trek to the romantic Heart Lake, followed by refreshing swim at Soochipara Falls.

itinerary.title: Kuruva Island Bamboo Rafting & Departure
itinerary.description: Float on pristine river rafts among dense evergreen canopies, souvenir shopping, and return journey.

title: Hampi Boulder Trails & Vijayanagara Heritage
summary: Step into a golden era of monolithic statues, stone chariots, and timeless ruins across boulder hills.
highlights: Vijaya Vittala Temple & musical pillars
Sunset view atop Matanga Hill & Tungabhadra River coracle ride
Royal Enclosure, Lotus Mahal, and Elephant Stables
inclusions: 3 Nights heritage hotel stay with pool
Daily breakfast and traditional thali dinners
Licensed ASI heritage guide throughout tours
Coracle boat ride & monument entrance fees

itinerary.title: Arrival & Virupaksha Temple
itinerary.description: Check-in, orientation walk along Hampi Bazaar, and sunset over Hemakuta Hill temples.

itinerary.title: The Grand Royal Architecture
itinerary.description: Explore Lotus Mahal, Zenana Enclosure, Queens Bath, and the towering monolith Narasimha.

itinerary.title: Vittala Temple & Anegundi Hipster Side
itinerary.description: See the iconic Stone Chariot, cross the Tungabhadra river via traditional round coracle, and visit Sanapur Lake.

itinerary.title: Matanga Hill Sunrise & Departure
itinerary.description: Panoramic 360-degree golden hour sunrise over Hampi ruins before return transfer to Hospet railway station.

title: Varkala Cliff, Waves & Sunset Serenity
summary: Perch atop iconic red laterite cliffs overlooking pristine golden sands and the Arabian Sea.
highlights: Cliffside cafes with international fusion cuisines
Beginner surf lesson at Black Beach
Sacred Papanasam Beach natural spring bath
inclusions: 2 Nights cliff-view boutique resort stay
Daily gourmet breakfasts and beach club access
1x Guided surf lesson with board & safety gear
Sunset yoga session with certified master

itinerary.title: Cliff Arrival & Sunset Chill
itinerary.description: Settle into your ocean-facing room, take a scenic walk on the North Cliff walkway, and enjoy live acoustic music.

itinerary.title: Surfing & Temple Springs
itinerary.description: Catch morning waves with expert instructors, explore 2000-year-old Janardhana Swamy Temple, and beach picnic.

itinerary.title: Anjengo Fort & Departure
itinerary.description: Quick heritage visit to colonial Anjengo Fort and lighthouse before departure towards Trivandrum.

title: Ooty & Coonoor Nilgiri Mountain Railway Odyssey
summary: Ride the historic UNESCO Toy Train through pine valleys, botanical gardens, and misty tea slopes.
highlights: UNESCO Toy train ride between Ooty and Coonoor
Dolphin's Nose viewpoint & Sim's Park botanical walks
Doddabetta Peak & handmade chocolate tasting
inclusions: 3 Nights stay in heritage British-era bungalow
Daily breakfast & 4-course dinner
Guaranteed reserved tickets for Nilgiri Mountain Toy Train
Full sightseeing in private cab
exclusions: Boat ride fees at Ooty Lake

itinerary.title: Arrival in Ooty & Botanical Garden
itinerary.description: Drive up the 36 hairpin bends of Kalhatty ghats. Visit Govt Botanical Garden and Rose Garden.

itinerary.title: Heritage Toy Train to Coonoor
itinerary.description: Board the vintage blue steam engine train through dark tunnels and mountain bridges to Coonoor. Visit Lamb's Rock.

itinerary.title: Doddabetta Peak & Pykara Falls
itinerary.description: Highest point in South India with telescope views, followed by speed boating at Pykara Lake.

itinerary.title: Chocolate Factory & Departure
itinerary.description: Watch artisanal chocolate making, pack gourmet Nilgiri tea packs, and head down towards Coimbatore.

title: Dandeli Wild Waters & Kali River Adventure
summary: Conquer Grade III Kali river rapids, natural jacuzzi baths, and deep wildlife jungle safaris.
highlights: 9 km Kali River white water rafting with Grade III rapids
Natural river whirlpool jacuzzi bath experience
Night jungle safari & hornbill birdwatching
inclusions: 2 Nights jungle campsite tent or cottage stay
All meals buffet (Veg & Non-Veg)
River rafting session with international safety gear
Kayaking, zorbing, and river crossing

itinerary.title: Jungle Camp Arrival & Kali Jacuzzi
itinerary.description: Reach campsite deep inside forest. Experience natural bubbling water massage in river rapids.

itinerary.title: White Water Rafting & Zipline
itinerary.description: Adrenaline-fueled 3-hour river rafting through gorge rapids, followed by high-speed flying fox zipline.

itinerary.title: Syntheri Rocks & Departure
itinerary.description: Trek down to monolithic granite Syntheri Rocks canyon and depart with adrenaline-filled memories.

title: Great Living Chola & Pandya Temples Circuit
summary: Marvel at thousand-year-old Dravidian granite gopurams, Bronze art, and vibrant temple rituals.
highlights: Meenakshi Amman Temple 14-tower complex & night ceremony
Thanjavur Brihadisvara (Big Temple) thousand-year monolithic dome
Chettinad heritage mansion architectural tour & culinary feast
inclusions: 3 Nights 4-star boutique hotel accommodation
Authentic South Indian breakfast and curated Chettinad lunch
VIP temple entry passes for seamless darshan
Dedicated cultural historian guide

itinerary.title: Madurai Arrival & Meenakshi Splendor
itinerary.description: Check-in and evening visit to the awe-inspiring Meenakshi Sundareswarar Temple to witness the ceremonial procession.

itinerary.title: Thirumalai Nayakkar Palace to Chettinad
itinerary.description: Tour the Italian-influenced stucco arches of Nayak Palace, then drive through Chettinad mansions and taste 7-course spice feast.

itinerary.title: Thanjavur Brihadisvara Wonder
itinerary.description: Stand before the 216-foot granite vimana built by Emperor Raja Raja Chola I. Visit Thanjavur Royal Palace Art Gallery.

itinerary.title: Bronze Casting Crafts & Departure
itinerary.description: Watch master artisans cast lost-wax Chola bronzes at Swamimalai before departure transfer to Trichy airport.
